Move money before you fly

Eligible students can transfer up to CAD $75,000 to their BMO chequing account before travelling. Once you activate your account in Canada, you can use the funds for tuition, a rent deposit, and first-week expenses.*

BMO waives its Global Money Transfer fee on eligible accounts and transactions under the NewStart® Program.*

Common questions

Good to know before you apply.

Still unsure? Write to care@aetherconnect.ai

Can I apply before I arrive in Canada?
Yes. Eligible international students can apply online for a BMO chequing account or Student GIC before travelling. BMO will provide the instructions for funding and activation.*
I’m still waiting for my letter of acceptance. Can I fill out the form?
Yes. Select Waiting for a decision when the form asks about your letter of acceptance. The documents you’ll need to apply depend on the BMO product you choose.
Is there a fee to check my eligibility?
The eligibility check is free. BMO product fees and terms apply.*
What documents should I have ready?
Have your passport, your letter of acceptance, and any study permit documents you’ve received. Follow BMO’s instructions for the documents your application requires.
